name: Omote-Sando
tagline: Shibuya in 3 minutes and Toranomon in 10 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥180,000 to ¥190,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, where Tokyo Metro run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 14 minutes to Otemachi, 13 minutes to Shinjuku, 3 minutes to Shibuya and 24 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥180,000 to ¥190,000. The station stands 33.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 10.7 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 33.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 23.6 m to 34.3 m, a difference of 10.7 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 22 clinics and 17 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 伊藤病院, about 4 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 北青山病院, about 4 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. Tokyo Metro Ginza Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line also call here. Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line are available too. All 3 lines are run by Tokyo Metro, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Ginza Line runs at 153% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 赤坂見附→溜池山王, which this station is not on. Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line runs at 150%. Its busiest stretch is 町屋→西日暮里, which this station is likewise not on. Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line runs at 111% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 渋谷→表参道, which includes this station. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥180,000 to ¥190,000, 1K ¥150,000 to ¥160,000, 1LDK ¥310,000 to ¥320,000 and 2LDK ¥530,000 to ¥540,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥180,000 to ¥190,000. For One room, 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Omote-Sando is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It takes 5 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Omote-Sando. One-room rents run about ¥9,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: Meiji-Jingumae is ahead on quiet, but Omote-Sando is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Omote-Sando.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who want another route when a line stops
People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
notFor: People who want to hold the rent down
noiseSources: 表参道 (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
青山通り (4 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 3 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
